name: mail-pane
description: Your latest mail beside the chat, through the Microsoft 365 connector: from one sender domain or the whole inbox, read in the pane, passed to the chat, with a toast when new mail comes in. /mail opens it.

domain.title: Sender domain
domain.description: Only mail sent from this domain or address (example.com). Empty shows the newest mail of the inbox.

watch.title: Watched senders
watch.description: Addresses or names, separated by commas, whose new mail raises a toast. Empty: every new mail of the domain does.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane looks for new mail.

connector.title: Microsoft 365 connector
connector.description: The connector's name as /mcp lists it.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the mail pane when a session starts. Where /mail does not run (the desktop app and other hosts), this or asking Claude for the mail opens it.
